aboutSection.intro: We design and build digital products with clean engineering and bold visuals.

who.title: Who we are
who.text: A small team of developers and designers who love building fast, modern products.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Help businesses grow online with websites and apps that are quick, clear and reliable.

how.title: How we work
how.text: Short iterations, regular demos and clear prices — you always know where the project is.

tech.title: Our technology
tech.text: Angular, TypeScript and modern cloud hosting, chosen to last and easy to maintain.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.text: We stay after launch with updates, monitoring and new features as you grow.

servicesSection.title: Our Services
servicesSection.intro: Everything you need to launch and grow online.

web-development.title: Web development
web-development.summary: Fast, modern websites and web apps built with Angular.
web-development.description: From landing pages to full web applications, we build sites that load fast, rank well and are easy to grow.

ui-ux-design.title: UI / UX design
ui-ux-design.summary: Interfaces that look sharp and are easy to use.
ui-ux-design.description: We design clear, accessible interfaces with a strong visual identity, from wireframes to the final pixel.

mobile-apps.title: Mobile apps
mobile-apps.summary: Apps for iOS and Android from a single codebase.
mobile-apps.description: We turn your idea into a mobile app that works offline, sends notifications and feels native on every phone.

support-maintenance.title: Support & maintenance
support-maintenance.summary: Updates, monitoring and fixes so your product keeps running.
support-maintenance.description: We keep your site or app secure and up to date, and we are there when something needs fixing.
